name: aihackr
description: Turn public webpages into Markdown, HTML, links and structured data using your private AIHackr workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Web data for your apps and agents
interface.longDescription: Scrape public webpages, discover page links, crawl sites and extract structured data. Uses your AIHackr account, private results and shared credits. OAuth account linking is planned; this development package requires an API-key-capable client.
defaultPrompt: Use AIHackr to turn a public webpage into Markdown.
Use AIHackr to extract structured information from a public URL.
